title.en: Woods and Valleys of Mount Yu

dimensions.en: Image: 37 1/4 x 14 1/8 in. (94.6 x 35.9 cm); Overall with mounting: 82 x 20 5/8 in. (208.3 x 52.4 cm); Overall with knobs: 82 x 24 5/8 in. (208.3 x 62.5 cm)

credit_line.en: Ex coll.: C. C. Wang Family, Gift of The Dillon Fund, 1973

intro.zh: 倪瓒是元代四大家之一。
intro.en: Ni Zan was one of the Four Masters of the Yuan dynasty.

intro.zh: 1366年，他为躲避兵乱离开家园；1368年明朝建立后，他仍过着四处漂泊的生活。
intro.en: In 1366 he left his home to escape marauding soldiers, and even after the Ming dynasty was founded in 1368 he lived as a wanderer.

intro.zh: 这幅画作于1372年，在他去世前两年；大都会博物馆说，它表达了画家安于隐居生活的心境。
intro.en: He painted this in 1372, two years before his death; the Met says it expresses his contentment in the life of a recluse.

intro.zh: 他的山水常画相隔很远的两岸，树木映着一片空阔的水面，画中从不出现人物。
intro.en: His landscapes show widely separated riverbanks, with trees set against an expanse of water, and never include people.

look_for.zh: 干而柔和的笔触，冷淡而克制。
look_for.en: Dry but tender brushwork, aloof and restrained.

look_for.zh: 近岸几棵树，中间是空阔的水面，远处是山。
look_for.en: A few trees on the near bank, open water, and hills beyond.

look_for.zh: 画上的诗以“看云弄笔，饮酒赋诗”的欢愉作结。
look_for.en: The poem on the painting, which ends with watching clouds, daubing with brushes, drinking wine and writing poems.

alt.zh: 一幅窄高的淡墨立轴：近景岩石上有几棵细树，中间是空白的水面，上方是圆缓的山丘。
alt.en: A tall, narrow hanging scroll in pale grey ink: a few thin trees on rocks in the foreground, empty water, and rounded hills at the top.

views.zh: 他写道，倪瓒晚年更加沉静内敛，散尽家财，戴黄冠、穿布衣，在湖山之间过隐士生活。
views.en: He wrote that in his late years Ni Zan grew quieter and more withdrawn, gave away all he owned, and roamed the lakes and mountains in a yellow Daoist cap and country clothes.

quote.en: he became quieter and more withdrawn than ever

views.zh: 馆方认为，画中宁静而明亮的气质，使它成为倪瓒晚年最完满的作品之一。
views.en: The museum finds a tranquil, luminous quality in it that makes it one of the most fully realized works of his later years.

note.zh: 每一句都对照所注出处核对过；找不到可靠出处的说法已删去或改写。
note.en: Every sentence was checked against the sources it cites; claims without a reliable source were cut or rewritten.
